name: pi-desktop
description: 基于本机 Pi Coding Agent CLI 的跨平台桌面工作台（Electron + Vue 3 + TypeScript）

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix packages/ui" "wait-on tcp:1420 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:ui
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/ui && node scripts/checks/transcript.check.ts && node scripts/checks/diff.check.ts && node scripts/checks/event-bus.check.ts && node scripts/checks/stage.check.ts && node scripts/checks/plugin-lifecycle.check.ts && node scripts/checks/host.check.ts && node scripts/checks/delete.check.ts && node scripts/checks/attachments.check.ts && node scripts/checks/files.check.ts && node scripts/checks/mermaid-fit.check.ts
